<function name="OverrideMove" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<added>2023.12.06</added>
	<description>
Called to completely override NPC movement. This can be used for example for flying NPCs.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="interval" type="number">Time interval for the movement, in seconds. Usually time since last movement.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return `true` to disable the default movement code.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
